name: Ken's Steak House Honey Mustard Dressing & Dip
whyItWorks: Smooth, sweet, and completely dairy-free. Uses finely ground mustard flour and pure honey, creating a creamy texture without cream, buttermilk, raw garlic, or heavy alliums. Very gentle chicken dip.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip plain baked or grilled chicken tenders into 1 tablespoon of honey mustard for comforting flavor.
watchOuts: Contains honey (fructose); enjoy in standard 1–2 tablespoon portions.
